title: Argument-Auditor Scope Extends to Argument-Graph Consumption and Pyramid Expansion-Fidelity Verification
summary: The `argument-auditor` specialist subagent's responsibilities are extended to include Argument-Graph consumption, pyramid graph-traversal, and expansion-fidelity verification when the primary document is an Essay-Outline (per ADR-092), anchored in `agents/argument-auditor.md` as Skill-Structure Layer instructions rather than domain-model vocabulary alone. Essay-Outline becomes a fourth named genre; the auditor traverses the four-tier pyramid (Abstract, Argument-Graph, Citation-Embedded Outline, References), verifies the Pyramid Refinement compliance test at three boundaries plus reverse-direction, assigns P1/P2/P3 severity to violations, and reports a pyramid coverage map and expansion-fidelity findings. The three existing genres' behavior is unchanged.
workflow_point: argument-audit dispatch on Essay-Outline genre documents (agents/argument-auditor.md)
mechanism: pyramid graph-traversal across four tiers plus expansion-fidelity verification at three boundaries plus reverse-direction, anchored as a new Process step

links.note: anchors the auditor's expanded scope in the Skill-Structure Layer substrate named in ADR-067 (as updated by ADR-089) — a concrete workflow step in agents/argument-auditor.md
the Skill-Structure Layer substrate's primacy and technique for this mechanism are unchanged by ADR-089's Harness Layer revision, which only revised the Harness Layer's own technique description

the ADR-092/ADR-093 separability (form vs. verification-mechanism as independently supersedable decisions) is methodology-pattern-derived, analogous to ADR-091's own separability from future ADRs that might amend the build skill independently of the dual-mode framing

anchors the Skill-Structure Layer verification mechanism (pyramid graph-traversal + expansion-fidelity verification) that ADR-092 §5 requires for its Pyramid Refinement structural property, filed as a conceptually separate, independently-supersedable decision
